title: Workflow orchestration
subtitle: Read the compiled Eino graph, start a versioned workflow and follow every node through the capability gateway.

graph.label: Compiled graph of {{name}} {{version}}
graph.hint: Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom
graph.layoutError: Unable to arrange the graph. Use the step list to inspect this workflow.

run.title: Run
run.hint: Acceptance is asynchronous. Approval and node calls still go through the gateway.
run.objectOnly: Input must be a JSON object.
run.forbidden: Starting a workflow needs the orchestration run grant.

trace.title: Node trace
trace.empty: No node call has been recorded for this run yet.

viewer.hint: Select a node or connection on the canvas or from the lists.
viewer.projection: This is the runtime graph projection. Root input data edges are hidden on the canvas; full DSL mappings, constants and Agent instructions are not exposed by this interface.
viewer.conditionUnavailable: The branch condition is not available in this projection.
viewer.noCondition: No condition; this connection expresses a dependency.
viewer.hiddenInputEdge: This root input data connection is hidden on the canvas.

editor.localHint: Edits are local drafts. They are not saved or published to the runtime.
editor.startHint: Hover a connection to insert a node, or hover beside a node to add a sibling branch (left/right in vertical layout; above/below in horizontal layout). Drafts are local to this view and are lost when you leave.
editor.draftHint: Unpublished local draft · not validated by the server. Undo or reset to return to the registered graph.
editor.runtimeHint: Run below always starts the registered version, not the local draft.
editor.catalogError: Unable to read the capability catalog.
editor.valueHint: Enter a JSON value, such as "approve", true or 1.
editor.originalHint: The original node also needs a distinct when value; no default branch is inferred.
editor.idInvalid: Use a unique step ID starting with a letter (up to 64 characters); input/start/end are reserved.
editor.budget: Enter a whole number within the displayed limit.
editor.agentRequired: Provide an instruction and at least one registered atomic tool.
editor.outputInvalid: Structured output must be an object Schema with properties.
editor.capabilityRequired: Choose a registered atomic capability and version.
editor.conditionMissing: Provide an upstream source, a field and a non-null JSON comparison value.
editor.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON objects for constants/mappings/Schema and valid JSON comparison values.
editor.stepLimit: A workflow may contain at most 64 business steps.
editor.dataEdge: Data connections map values; select a control or branch connection to insert a step.
editor.targetMissing: The insertion target no longer exists.
editor.conditionGroup: Sibling branches must use the same source node and field.
editor.originalCaseError: Provide a comparison value for the original branch.
editor.duplicateCase: This branch comparison value already exists.
editor.branchDependencies: Conditional steps may only depend on their condition source and root input. Resolve other dependencies first.
editor.mappingSource: Mappings may only reference workflow input or nodes upstream of the insertion point.
editor.caseType: Sibling comparison values must have the same JSON type as the existing branch.
editor.conditionFieldInvalid: The source output Schema does not declare this condition field.
editor.removeProtected: Start and end nodes cannot be removed.
editor.removeConditionSource: Other branches use this node as their condition source. Update those conditions before removing it.
editor.removeDataSource: Other nodes reference this node’s output. Update those mappings before removing it.
editor.removeAmbiguous: The branch condition cannot be transferred to these successors automatically. Adjust the branch before removing this node.
